item.name: Kona Snorkeling in Pawai Bay
item.description:
##Description
Skip the crowds at Kealakekua Bay and snorkel our stunning local sites instead - only accessible by boat. With just a 10 - 15 minute boat ride instead of a 45-minute ride, you'll spend more time in the water getting up close and personal with the gorgeous fish on one or two of our lovely local reefs.  Less time on the water means more time in the water!  Discover the volcanic formations and dramatic arches made by past lava flows.

* Duration: 2.5 hours

Our afternoon snorkeling trip takes place in Pawai Bay - ocean permitting - only accessible to guests by boat - that area of coastline is set aside for the use of native Hawaiian children, inaccessible to non-natives. We are fortunate to be able to moor in the bay and share the beautiful shallow reef wildlife and educational briefings with guests about the wildlife we encounter.  With an abundance of endemic fish, this area is lush with life.

##Inclusions
* Mask, snorkel, fins, floatation devices

##Trip Details
* Duration: 2.5 hours
* **This is not a suitable activity for non-swimmers, expectant mothers, those with back or neck issues, or any current injuries or health issues.  You will be denied boarding or entry to the water if we feel it is unsafe for you to participate in the activity and no refund will be offered.**
* Non-swimmers can enjoy the views while relaxing in the sun.

Visit our extensive [FAQ's](https://konasnorkeltrips.com/faq/) to find the answers to any questions.

* 🕒 Arrive on Time (Plan to arrive 10-15 minutes early)
* ✍️ Complete Your Digital Waiver (before arrival—no exceptions)
* 🥽 Gear Provided: Mask, snorkel, fins, flotation devices
* 👥 Minimum: 6 guests required for the charter to operate
* 📌 Need more info? [Check out our FAQ](https://konasnorkeltrips.com/faq/) 

#🚑 Medical & Health Advisory
Your safety is our top priority. If we determine it is unsafe for you to participate, you will be denied boarding or entry into the water. This includes:

* Physical limitations that prevent safe boarding or snorkeling
* Inability to swim confidently or follow safety instructions
* Please evaluate your group’s readiness for this tour before check-in.

#⚠️ Top Tips for a Smooth Trip
 🕒 1. Be On Time!
* Arrive 10-15 minutes early to avoid delays.
* Arriving 15+ minutes late = seat forfeiture (no refunds or rebooking).

📄 2. Sign Your Waiver Before Arrival
* All waivers must be completed digitally on your own device prior to check-in.

👜 3. Pack Light – It’s a Wet Ride!
* The Orca is a wet boat, and seaspray is common.
* Storage is limited—leave unnecessary items on land.
* Bring a small dry bag for essentials only.

👙 4. Come Dressed for Adventure
* Wear your swimsuit under sun-protective clothing.
* Shade is limited—a rash guard helps protect you from the sun.

🌞 5. Use Reef-Safe Sunscreen
* No spray sunscreen! Apply reef-safe lotion to protect marine life.

🚤 6. Embrace the Adventure!
* This is a retired Navy SEAL boat—it’s fast, exciting, and perfect for thrill-seekers.
* Bring your sense of adventure along for the ride!

#🔄 Rescheduling & Rebooking

Within 48 hours: Changes are not allowed. This policy helps us fill your spots.

🔴 Non-Refundable Tickets: No refunds—no exceptions.

Flexible Cancellation Upgrade for Refundable Tickets
If you purchased the upgrade, your cancellation window has been extended up to **12 hours** before the start of the trip. You’ll be refunded 50% of your trip. 

🔹 No-shows & late arrivals are not eligible for refunds.

#🌐 Additional Information
📧 International Guests: We’ll only contact you via email, so check your inbox regularly for trip updates.

🚨Full face masks are not permitted on any of our trips due to safety concerns.

💰 Tipping: Show your crew some love! Tipping is customary in this industry—cash or Venmo is welcome.

📸 Share Your Experience:

Tag us on Instagram: @konasnorkeltrips
Use hashtag: #konasnorkeltrips

We commit to our employees and other guests and adhere to our cancellation policy regardless of circumstances.  ***We recommend travel insurance or a premium credit card with trip protection to cover unexpected disruptions such as illness, injury, severe weather, or airline/travel disruption. etc.***

**Refundable Ticket:**
Cancellation: Full refund if canceled up to 48 hours before the trip.
Rebooking: Free rebooking up to 48 hours before the trip.

**All cancellation requests must be submitted in writing at least 48 hours before the trip's start. Reservations made within 48 hours are not eligible for a refund.**

**Non-Refundable Ticket:**
Cancellation: No refunds. All Sales are Final
Rebooking: Rebooking is allowed up to 48 hours before the trip.

###Flexible Cancellation Upgrade for Refundable Tickets
If you purchased the upgrade, your cancellation window has been extended up to **12 hours** before the start of the trip. You’ll be refunded 50% of your trip. 

###No Shows and Late Arrivals will not be refunded or rescheduled.

###What if we cancel?

We reserve the right to cancel for any reason, including, but not limited to, weather, ocean conditions, passenger count, mechanical issues, or safety for you, our guests, and our crew. We’ll do our best to reschedule your trip based on availability, or you’ll be issued a refund in full.

###Double Check Your Dates Before Completing Your Booking!
If you booked the wrong date and do not contact us more than 48-Hours in Advance of the trip, no rebooking or refund will be offered.

###Contact Information
International guests: we can only contact you by the email you've provided or via text in our reservation system. Please check your email regularly, as we may need to send you important information about your trip. ALL GUESTS: We are not responsible if we cannot contact you through the information you've provided regarding important information about the trip.  

###Identification
***The name on your credit card must match the contact name on your booking.*** *For your security, at check-in, you may be required to present the credit card that was used to pay for your booking, along with a matching valid photo ID

There is free parking available in the parking lot.  If you end up at the boat ramps, you are on the WRONG SIDE of the harbor
